compatibility.v1AndV2: PV-ENHANCE-I2I-001 and PV-ENHANCE-I2I-002 remain readable and executable by their exact existing writers
compatibility.operationEnvelope: schema v3 is additive inside operation=i2i and uses the existing durable queue
compatibility.malformedOrFuture: reader-only unsupported row; never coerce, execute, retry, reorder, open, or delete as a managed image enhancement

edits.blankMeaning: do not unlock or alter that region

outfitMaskExpandPixels.meaning: work-resolution pixels added around the detected clothing region

seed.missing: choose once at enqueue and persist the resolved integer

requestV3.normalization: trim each directive without rewriting its wording

promptV3.construction: persist one compact line per nonblank directive using stable labels; append one short unlisted-region preservation line only when overall is blank
promptV3.policyText: do not append verbose policy or safety prose to the ordinary generation prompt
promptV3.visibility: the exact persisted directive snapshot and generation settings are local user data and may be shown and copied in the native UI
promptV3.hash: promptSnapshotSha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of the exact prompt UTF-8 bytes

snapshotV3.unknownFields: preserve when a compatible writer rewrites the row
snapshotV3.retry: reuse the complete persisted preset, directives, resolved mask expansion, seed, and source provenance without rebuilding from current UI settings

executionV3.queue: run exactly one job through the single durable Enhancement queue
executionV3.candidate: generate one full-frame FLUX candidate from all nonblank directives
executionV3.overall: a nonblank overall directive explicitly permits the validated full candidate frame
executionV3.expression: use a bounded full-face envelope rather than a lips-only mask
executionV3.outfit: use clothing segmentation plus the persisted automatic or manual expansion envelope while protecting face and hair
executionV3.pose: use a bounded person envelope while protecting face and hair
executionV3.background: use the outside of the union of source and candidate person masks; require strict alignment unless pose is also requested
executionV3.blankRegion: a blank scoped directive does not apply its composite pass
executionV3.publication: publish one managed output only after source identity, mask bounds, candidate dimensions, cleanup, and changed-pixel checks pass
executionV3.source: never rewrite or delete the selected source image

provenanceV3.durableAuthority: the exact preset.options snapshot in the job row
provenanceV3.pngParameters: include the compact user directive prompt and numeric settings so a copied managed output remains inspectable
provenanceV3.nativeViewer: show the structured per-field directives and numeric settings from the exact generating job and provide copy actions
provenanceV3.namedStyles: native UI styles copy request fields only; applying a style never enqueues until the user explicitly starts editing

capabilityV3.enqueueGate: all readiness booleans must be exactly true before publishing or waking
capabilityV3.notReady: return 503 I2I_BACKEND_NOT_READY without writing a job or waking the queue
capabilityV3.passiveRead: health and Jobs reads never load models or start the worker
